# Networks.ipv4 property

The IPv4 networks, as a [NetworkList](/api/net/latest/net.networklist/) — reachable as `.ipv4`<!-- -->.

**Signature:**

```typescript
readonly [NetworkType.IPV4]: NetworkList;
```

## Remarks

Left unset when the set has no IPv4 networks, despite the non-null assertion in its declaration, so check it before use. [Networks.includes()](/api/net/latest/net.networks.includes/) already does. Its [NetworkList.networks](/api/net/latest/net.networklist.networks/) buffer is what the constructor's first argument accepts back.
